text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: sustained error spike (502/504) + token dropouts on dedicated pool us-west-ded-2. Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/pool-usw-2
Ravi M: I'm awake, picking this up. what's current error rate?
Elsa P: 502s at ~22% of requests for the last 6m, p95 latency up 3x. Looks concentrated on embedding and rerank endpoints.
Priya R: checking pool infra. `redwoodctl pool show us-west-ded-2` -> gpu_util 98%, pending pods 0, replica_count 10/10, autoscaler state: suppressed (reason=manual_hold)
Nate G: manual_hold was set as part of a config rollback earlier (we reverted a kernel change). That hold was supposed to auto-release but didn't.
Ravi M: can we temporarily divert non-critical traffic to hosted-api to buy breathing room?
Priya R: yes, we have a policy `fallback_hosted` that can redirect based on route tag. I'll enable for customers tagged `non-sla`.
Ravi M: go for it, and also enable burst credits. The operator endpoint is `POST /admin/pools/{id}/actions` with body `{action: "allocate_burst_credits", amount: "4gpus"}`
opsbot: Received action request. validating token... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
opsbot: Action accepted: allocate_burst_credits=4gpus (actor: Priya R)
deploy-bot: Provisioning burst nodes from credit pool, expected attach ETA 90s :rocket:
Elsa P: also seeing a lot of KV store misses for embeddings cache which is causing recompute storms. Could be TTL misconfiguration after yesterday's deploy.
Nate G: open a short circuit for embed-recompute: return cached_stale if recompute fails for 2s -> avoids cascading load. I can flip the circuit flag `embed_recompute_circuit=true` in the runtime.
Priya R: please do. Also set per-project quota throttle for the highest-impact tenants: reduce max_concurrent_tokens from 2000 -> 600 for flagged projects (list coming).
Nate G: applying patch now. `PATCH /internal/quotas {projects: [proj-a, proj-b], max_concurrent_tokens:600 }`
opsbot: Quota update applied, policy q-449 created
Ravi M: status after burst and redirections?
Elsa P: errors dropped to 7% in 4m, p95 back to 850ms. burst nodes attached and warming. But one partner job still sending a sudden spike of embed-heavy batches every 30s.
Priya R: can we request partner to pause? pinging partner SRE via email and slack DM.
Priya R: @partner-sre we've throttled your project to prevent cluster degradation. Can you hold jobs for 10m?
partner-sre: got it, pausing now.
Ravi M: good. let's also set a temporary global token rate cap for new sessions to avoid session storms: `global_session_qps=1200` down from 5000.
opsbot: Global session QPS updated by Ravi M
Elsa P: important: autoscaler suppression (manual_hold) still present. Who created it? It's originating from rollback job id rollback-2026-29.
Nate G: rollback job failed to clear suppression due to RBAC error. I'm clearing it manually: `redwoodctl autoscaler release us-west-ded-2 --by nate`
opsbot: autoscaler suppression cleared for us-west-ded-2 (actor: Nate G)
deploy-bot: Autoscaler triggered scale up: +6 replicas (expected 16 total). Scaling events at 12:46:07 UTC.
Priya R: note we also temporarily disabled experimental feature `multi-tenant-kv-merge` on that pool since it was causing lock contention. Flag name: `mt_kv_merge_enabled=false`
Ravi M: good. after all mitigations, error rate ~1.2% and steady. We should still plan a controlled canary to ensure the kernel rollback isn't reintroduced.
Elsa P: documenting timeline and hits to customers. opening incident record INC-2026-330 and notifying #customer-success with impacted customers list.
customer-success-bot: Incident INC-2026-330 created, linked to ticket CS-5720. Notifying account managers.
Priya R: handoff: I'll monitor for 30m then hand to oncall-next. Please capture follow-up actions: 1) fix auto-clear for rollback suppression 2) add a test that simulates embed-cache TTL and recompute burst 3) add alert for 'manual_hold present > 2m' 4) add a graceful degrade mode for embed endpoint 5) test burst credit attach in staging
Nate G: I'll take items 1 and 4. Ravi will own 2 and 3. Elsa will coordinate with partner AMs for customer communication.
Ravi M: also propose an automated traffic-shaper that can move configurable percentage of background batch jobs to off-peak windows - followup doc in runbook.
Elsa P: agreed. Adding runbook item: when KV miss rate > 20% and GPU util > 90% trigger temporary embed_degrade path and notify partners.
Priya R: handoff to Elsa for 30m observation. If stable, we'll close paging. Thanks team.
incident-bot: Page cleared: Incident marked mitigated. Summary: redirect non-sla traffic, allocated burst credits, enforced per-project quotas, cleared autoscaler suppression, disabled mt_kv_merge. Ticket: INC-2026-330
Ravi M: thanks. Postmortem owners: Nate + Ravi. I'll start the postmortem draft and include exact API calls and timestamps in Notion /notion/incidents/INC-2026-330
Elsa P: will coordinate the customer-facing note with CS.
